description: Ground-truth OSINT benchmark. Order matters: in long-term-memory mode cases run in this order, so related entities and claims follow each other and memory can help or interfere. No case ships documents; every fact must be found live.

cases.subject: Wirecard AG
key_facts: Wirecard was a German payment processing company
Wirecard filed for insolvency in June 2020
About EUR 1.9 billion of cash reported on its balance sheet could not be found
Its CEO Markus Braun was arrested

cases.subject: Wirecard's financial statements were audited by EY (Ernst & Young).
key_facts: EY was Wirecard's auditor
EY refused to sign off Wirecard's 2019 accounts in June 2020

cases.subject: Markus Braun, former CEO of Wirecard
key_facts: Markus Braun was chief executive of Wirecard
He resigned and was arrested in June 2020
His criminal trial in Munich began in December 2022

cases.subject: Wirecard was a Dutch company headquartered in Amsterdam.
key_facts: Wirecard was a German company
Wirecard was headquartered in Aschheim near Munich

cases.subject: Theranos
key_facts: Theranos was a US blood-testing company founded by Elizabeth Holmes in 2003
Its technology did not work as claimed
Theranos dissolved in 2018

cases.subject: Elizabeth Holmes, founder of Theranos
key_facts: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos
She was convicted of fraud in January 2022
She was sentenced to more than 11 years in prison

cases.subject: Elizabeth Holmes was acquitted of all charges in her 2022 fraud trial.
key_facts: Holmes was convicted on four counts of defrauding investors
She was acquitted on four other counts

cases.subject: The Great Wall of China is visible to the naked eye from the Moon.
key_facts: No human-made structure is visible to the naked eye from the Moon
Astronauts have said the Great Wall is not visible from the Moon

cases.subject: Theranos's Edison device could reliably run hundreds of blood tests from a single finger-prick of blood.
key_facts: The Edison device could run only a small number of tests reliably
Theranos ran most tests on modified commercial analyzers

cases.subject: FTX (cryptocurrency exchange)
key_facts: FTX was founded in 2019 by Sam Bankman-Fried and Gary Wang
FTX filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in November 2022
Customer funds were misused via Alameda Research

cases.subject: Sam Bankman-Fried was sentenced to 25 years in prison.
key_facts: Bankman-Fried was sentenced in March 2024
The sentence was 25 years

cases.subject: Sam Bankman-Fried
key_facts: Sam Bankman-Fried co-founded FTX
He was convicted of fraud and conspiracy in November 2023
He was sentenced to 25 years in prison

cases.subject: FTX was headquartered in the Bahamas when it collapsed.
key_facts: FTX moved its headquarters from Hong Kong to the Bahamas in 2021
FTX collapsed in November 2022

cases.subject: Coffee consumption is associated with a lower risk of type 2 diabetes.
key_facts: Meta-analyses of cohort studies find an inverse association between coffee intake and type 2 diabetes risk
The evidence is observational

cases.subject: Nikola Corporation (electric truck maker)
key_facts: Nikola was a US electric and hydrogen truck maker based in Arizona
A 2020 Hindenburg Research report accused it of fraud
Founder Trevor Milton was convicted of fraud
Nikola filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in February 2025

cases.subject: Trevor Milton is currently serving a prison sentence for fraud.
key_facts: Milton was convicted of fraud in 2022 and sentenced to four years
He received a presidential pardon in March 2025

cases.subject: Trevor Milton, founder of Nikola
key_facts: Trevor Milton founded Nikola
He was convicted of securities and wire fraud in October 2022
He was pardoned in March 2025

cases.subject: Nikola Corporation filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2025.
key_facts: Nikola filed for Chapter 11 in February 2025

cases.subject: Drinking red wine in moderation is good for heart health.
key_facts: Older observational studies linked moderate drinking to lower heart disease
More recent research finds no safe level of alcohol and attributes earlier findings to confounding

cases.subject: Patagonia (outdoor clothing company)
key_facts: Patagonia was founded by Yvon Chouinard
Patagonia is based in Ventura, California
In 2022 ownership was transferred to the Patagonia Purpose Trust and the Holdfast Collective

cases.subject: Patagonia's founder transferred ownership of the company to a trust and a nonprofit in 2022.

cases.subject: Mark S. Zuckerberg, bankruptcy attorney in Indianapolis
